initialize_torch_distributed: initialize torch distributed process group with NCCL backend for multi-GPU tensor parallelism
create_FakeGroup: create a FakeGroup process group mock for single-GPU or debug mode testing
create_FakeBarrier: create a FakeBarrier no-op barrier for single-process distributed simulation
configure_MEMORY_FRACTION: configure CUDA memory fraction via the CUDA_MEMORY_FRACTION environment variable
set_tensor_parallelism_env: set RANK and WORLD_SIZE environment variables for tensor parallelism configuration
